head.name: @fzlt/core/embed
head.lead: Drop a game onto any page with one small config. palette - hex colours for the Board UI roles (anything else is ignored: no CSS injection) easterEgg - false: open now. true / {...}: stay dormant (tiny listeners only) until a trigger (key sequence, gesture on a selector, click on a selector), then lazy-load the game. toggle - a floating key to reopen / close once unlocked. Escape closes and restores the page. Lifted from Swarm Protocol's loader: keys typed in fields never count, only a position and a timestamp are kept for the sequence (never the typed text), and destroy() removes everything.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
